feature_name: Tokenizer ID Validation for HuggingFace Pipeline
description: Add validation logic to ensure proper initialization of pad_token_id and eos_token_id when using the HuggingFacePipeline. This should prevent the same type of tokenizer configuration bug that was reported in HuggingFace's TGI and ensure models like Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct work correctly with text generation tasks.
functional_requirements: Check model config for pad_token_id and eos_token_id during pipeline initialization
Handle cases where these token IDs might be missing or improperly set in the model configuration
Add appropriate fallback logic to ensure tokenizer works correctly for text generation
Include tests to verify the fix works with models that previously exhibited this issue
Ensure the fix doesn't break existing functionality with models that already have proper tokenizer configuration
